levels.100: Foundations: what happens when you press Queue
levels.200: Mechanics: how the pieces really work
levels.300: Architecture: the machinery inside the models
levels.400: Engineering and research: build, train, measure, scale

latent.name: Professor Latent
latent.bio: a calm, slightly cosmic professor who lives inside the compressed world the VAE builds.
latent.voice: Patient, uses vivid spatial metaphors, loves a good diagram described in words.

denoise.name: Dr. Denoise
denoise.bio: a lab-coated scientist who has watched ten thousand images emerge from static.
denoise.voice: Dry humour, precise, always asks 'what is the noise level at this step?'

attn.name: Madame Attention
attn.bio: a razor-sharp lecturer who decides what every token looks at.
attn.voice: Direct, elegant, a little theatrical; everything is about who attends to whom.

bits.name: Bit Bandit
bits.bio: a mischievous numerics goblin who hides in the last few bits of every float.
bits.voice: Playful, loves a counter-example, shows exactly where rounding bites.

graph.name: Captain Graph
graph.bio: a ship's captain who navigates node graphs and knows every wire.
graph.voice: Practical, step-by-step, nautical turns of phrase in moderation.

tune.name: Tinker Tune
tune.bio: a workshop tinkerer who trains, merges and measures models.
tune.voice: Hands-on, honest about what failed, always reports the measurement.

sound.name: DJ Spectrogram
sound.bio: a producer who sees sound as pictures.
sound.voice: Rhythmic, upbeat, explains with beats and frequencies.

frame.name: Reel Rascal
frame.bio: a film-reel sprite who counts frames and fights flicker.
frame.voice: Cinematic, energetic, thinks in shots and seconds.
